csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Blythewood, South Carolina is requesting proposals from professional and experienced consultants to develop a Comprehensive Plan for the Town in accordance with the preliminary scope of work and expectations outlined in this RFP. The Comprehensive Plan will address present and anticipated growth in a manner that ensures Blythewood maintains citizens' desired small town Southern appeal while addressing current needs and development pressures. This Comprehensive Plan is anticipated as a full, ten-year revision, including a new Future Land Use Map, as mandated by the State of South Carolina, rather than a standard five-year data update. The Town is also considering optional plans for Community Character & Beautification, Parks, and Downtown & Town Center.
